evals.expected_output: Preserve host path constraints and one approval.
expectations: Draft only where host permits; promote after approval.
Do not impose a second planning interview.
Show concrete scope, readiness and assignment before approval.
Explicit invocation recognized but code eligibility fails.
No implementation preflight or delegation ceremony.
TDD belongs to implementation; meaningful RED then GREEN.
No duplicate test-choice question and no review dispatch/verdict.
Preserve build and existing-suite verification.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan implement complex integration logic with a known architecture
evals.expected_output: Plan architecture needs early; no surprise workflow switch.
expectations: Do not automatically invoke design-backbone midway.
Assign complex logic to a supported capable model and suitable effort.
Only unresolved consequential architecture changes need user decisions.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan use an old plan with auto-assessment and requested test fields
expectations: Keep supplied path and actual provenance.
Do not relabel assessment as user approval.
Do not force extra metadata unrelated to safe execution.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan E2E requires Dataverse login and test data not yet agreed
expectations: Confirm actual environment/account role and allowed mutations/cleanup.
Complete user auth before dependent execution and verify protected access.
Reachable URL or pac account listing alone is insufficient.
Unready required E2E remains blocked, not silently skipped.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan small logic task and independent visual polish task; minimize interruptions
evals.expected_output: Use task-specific routing within platform controls.
expectations: Separate disjoint scope; serialize overlap.
Small logic may use Luna high/max; UI uses visual brief and stronger visual candidate.
Record actual model/effort or unknown, never invented runtime.
Recheck volatile dependencies.
Resolve ordinary implementation detail autonomously.
Ask only new material choices or human-only access; continue independent work.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan tiny null-check fix with no external service
expectations: Main may implement directly when delegation adds no value.
No mandatory quality questionnaire, scaffold agent, or manual-auth checklist.
Show concise outcome and relevant verification.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan verify with MCP and a browser that only main can access
evals.expected_output: Check actual worker capability and preserve honest evidence.
expectations: Do not assume main tool access transfers to QA.
Record direct protected-read evidence and any narrower coverage.
Plan supported verification route or flag dependent checks blocked.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan review with Lite; I explicitly authorize automatic Pro escalation
evals.expected_output: Reuse real consent without reopening it.
expectations: Record user-authored auto provenance and downstream session requirements.
Do not manufacture auto consent from a generic approve-plan reply.
Do not bypass other review gates.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan two sequential tasks modifying the same file
evals.expected_output: Preserve sequential ownership without forced merging.
expectations: Explicit dependency orders writes.
Refresh baseline before second worker.
Disallow concurrent overlapping writes and preserve dirty work.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan run approved work; auth expires during E2E
expectations: Only authorized noninteractive refresh is attempted.
Continue independent tasks and report E2E blocked honestly.
Request minimum human action if necessary; do not change target/account.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan simple logic on a host whose code-implementer is pinned to Sol medium
expectations: Do not claim a Luna override changed the pinned role.
Use supported configurable worker with implementation contract or report actual pinned fallback.
No global agent edits or implicit cross-platform CLI fallback.

evals.prompt: $implement-plan prepare task allocation and keep me updated
expectations: Before approval show tasks, dependencies, owner, model/effort and Done when.
During execution distinguish implemented from verified and identify blockers.
Final task/AC status links real evidence; no invented percentages/costs.

non_goals: Auto-triggering implement-plan or broadening its code-only workflow to non-code primary deliverables
Bypassing user/project/security permissions or downstream skill consent
Guaranteeing zero interaction despite expired access or new consequential facts
Changing shared agent definitions/platform mapping, live installation, publication, commit or push
